title: 第3章 纳尼这是剑与魔法的世界第4章 会打有个屁用
slug: 我在西幻世界独断万古
content_zh:
村口距离领主府很远，坐马车也需要三天。
季天坐在车尾的横板上，屁股已经被颠得发麻，可他的表情始终平静。
这两天，他观察了这支队伍：两个骑士，五个扈从，七个士兵，一个老管家，一个小姐，还有他。
两个骑士都是上过战场的人。
领头的那个叫雷德，三十出头，左脸有一道被箭矢擦过的旧伤。
另一个年轻些，叫艾伦，话不多，但下马时的动作比雷德还利落——也是个在刀尖上舔过血的主。
士兵们就差一些了，大多是领地里家世清白的自由民子弟，会列队会听令，但真要打起来，季天觉得自己能在十息之内放倒其中任意三个。
至于扈从……就是伺候马匹和行李的，不值一提。
他真正在意的是老管家和那个始终没露面的小姐。
老管家名叫格里高，据说是从王都跟着小姐一起过来的，在领主府里当了三十多年的管家。
这种人见多识广，心思深沉，不是那么好糊弄的。
季天能感觉到，这两天里，格里高至少透过车帘观察了他不下十次。
而那个小姐……
季天瞥了一眼紧闭的车帘，若有所思。
他听见过的声音不多，但在他说出“能让小姐出门”那句话时的那一声轻响，马车里传来的那声碰撞，都不像是无意碰到的。
像是有人听到了意料之外的话，身体先于理智做出了反应。
有意思。
第二天中午，马车在一处驿站停下换马。
季天跳下车活动筋骨，趁这个空当走到驿站的水井边打水喝。
驿站里还歇着几个行商模样的人，正围坐在一起吃东西。他们的口音和村里人不太一样，带着一种季天听不太懂的卷舌音。

“听说了吗？北边的狼人又闹起来了。”
“狼人算什么，东边那窝哥布林才烦人，上个月把我表兄的货队劫了，三个人被拖进洞里，找到的时候只剩骨头。”
“啧，这些魔物越来越猖狂了。教会的人也不管管？”
“管？拿什么管？圣殿骑士团主力被调去西境对抗魔王军了，剩下的都驻守在大城市，咱们这种穷乡僻壤，能有个中级魔法师坐镇就算烧高香了。”
季天打水的动作顿了一下。
狼人？
哥布林？
魔法师？
魔王？
他慢慢直起身，转头看了那群行商一眼。几个人正埋头吃东西，没人注意到他的目光。
季天把水瓢放下，沉默了几秒。
……哦。
原来这个世界有魔物。
content_en:
The entrance to the village is far away from the lord's mansion, and it takes three days by carriage.
Ji Tian sat on the horizontal board at the rear of the car, his buttocks were numb from the jolt, but his expression remained calm.
In the past two days, he observed this team: two knights, five retinues, seven soldiers, an old housekeeper, a young lady, and him.
Both knights were men who had been on the battlefield.
The leader, named Red, was in his early thirties and had an old wound on the left side of his face that had been grazed by an arrow.
The other one was younger, named Allen. He didn't talk much, but his movements when dismounting were more agile than Red's - he was also a master who had licked blood on the tip of a knife.
The soldiers were a bit worse. Most of them were the children of free citizens with innocent family backgrounds in the territory. They could line up and obey orders. But if they really wanted to fight, Ji Tian felt that he could knock down any three of them within ten breaths.
As for the retinue...they just serve the horses and luggage, not worth mentioning.
What he really cared about was the old housekeeper and the young lady who never showed up.
The old butler's name is Gregor. It is said that he came with the young lady from the royal capital and has been a butler in the lord's mansion for more than thirty years.
This kind of person is well-informed and thoughtful, and is not so easy to fool.
Ji Tian could feel that Gregor had observed him through the car curtain at least ten times in the past two days.
And that lady...
Ji Tian glanced at the closed car curtain, thoughtfully.
He had not heard many sounds, but the soft sound when he said the words "Let the lady go out" and the collision from the carriage did not seem to be accidental.
It was as if someone heard something unexpected, and his body reacted before his mind.
interesting.
At noon the next day, the carriage stopped at a post station to change horses.
Ji Tian jumped out of the car to stretch his muscles and took advantage of the opportunity to walk to the well at the inn to get some water.
There were also a few businessmen sitting around the inn, eating together. Their accents were different from those in the village, with a retroflex tone that Ji Tian couldn't quite understand.
"Have you heard? The werewolves in the north are making trouble again."
"Werewolves are nothing. That nest of goblins in the east is annoying. Last month, they robbed my cousin's cargo convoy. Three people were dragged into the cave. When they were found, there were only bones left."
"Tsk, these monsters are getting more and more rampant. Don't the people in the church care about them?"
"Care? What to care about? The main force of the Templar Knights has been transferred to the Western Region to fight against the Demon King's army. The rest are stationed in big cities. In a remote country like ours, it would be a blessing to have a mid-level magician to take charge."
Ji Tian paused while fetching water.
Werewolf?
Goblin?
Magician?
Demon King?
He slowly straightened up and turned to look at the group of merchants. Several people were immersed in eating, and no one noticed his gaze.
Ji Tian put down the water ladle and was silent for a few seconds.
……oh.
It turns out there are monsters in this world.
